Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I wanted to put a short note to kick off the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have clear owners, milestones, and a tight 8-week evaluation window. The goal of this MAP is to get a pilot running with a production-like workload and measure latency/cost baselines so you can make an informed go/no-go by the end of June.

High level proposal (attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx):
- Goal: Pilot Redwood Inference (hosted) with 1 model for triage workflows; measure latency, token cost, and accuracy on the sample prompt set.
- Timeline: 8 weeks (start: Apr 26, checkpoint at week 2 and week 6, decision week of Jun 22).
- Who:
  - Champion / Customer PM: Sam Patel (Lincoln Health) — lead for clinical/ops sign-off
  - AE / Redwood lead: Hannah Schmitt — commercial and scheduling
  - Solutions engineer: Jonas Weber — eval plan, measurement hooks
  - CS/Onboarding: Marissa Cole — rollout and success criteria

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm the internal stakeholders (clinical lead + security reviewer) who should be on the MAP?
2) Any mandatory compliance checks (e.g., data residency) we should slot into week 1?
3) Is the proposed timeline workable from your side (decision week Jun 22)?

I've attached a lightweight MAP spreadsheet with suggested milestones and a draft SOW-term-sheet for procurement to glance at. Jonas and I will follow up with a 30-minute orientation call to walk through the milestones and measurement plan — proposed window next Tue/Wed afternoon PT.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
